title: This site
summary: Working-in-public portfolio in Vue 3 + Tailwind 4. Built as its own design playground.
body:
This is my site, I built it because I wanted somewhere public to put the work I actually do. Projects, demos, notes, that kind of thing. The typical resume portfolio template never really fit the way I think about what I'm building, so I just made my own.

It's Vue 3 with Tailwind 4, using the new `@theme` directive so there's no config file. Vite for the build, a lightweight Vue Router setup, and no CMS. List content lives in typed JSON files under `src/content/` and the singleton stuff, about me, education, work history, lives separately in `src/data/`. Detail pages render markdown through marked.

The comic theme isn't just for looks either. Every panel sits at a slight angle, every hover lifts it up like you're peeling back to "the next page" underneath. It's a work in progress by design, the site is the playground, I'm figuring out the design as I go.
